thread:
Maya: Hey team — VerdeBank wants to move forward with a short POC. They asked for a SOC 2 artifact pack (redacted report + controls mapping), a pen-test attestation letter we can sign, and a simple infra diagram for Private (VPC + customer KMS). Also pricing: they want a 6‑month dedicated commit estimate for ~4x A100-equivalent sustained capacity. Can Security/Eng/Quotes help? cc @Sam @Marta @Eli
Sam: Can you DM me the customer's legal entity + primary security contact? I can prepare the pen-test attestation template. Note: we'll need them to sign an NDA before we can share vulnerability write-ups.
Marta: I can make a one-page architecture diagram (png + bullets). Quick question — do they want flow-level network ACL/IP ranges, or just component-level (load balancer -> frontend -> inference pool -> storage)?
Maya: Component-level only is fine. They asked us to call out KMS ownership (customer-managed) and audit logs retention. No on‑prem for now, VPC only.
Eli: For pricing: when you say 4x A100-equivalent, is that sustained 24/7 or peak? That materially changes reserved pricing vs burst. If sustained, I can ballpark monthly commit.
Maya: They confirmed sustained baseline for expected traffic.
Abi: FYI SalesOps — we'll need to include SOC2 summary, control owners list, and the signed pen-test attestation. I can assemble the evidence bundle and provision an SFTP link for them.
Sam: Ok I can pull a redacted SOC2 Type II report + controls mapping. ETA: EOD Wed if I get the customer contact today. Pen-test attestation I can draft tomorrow morning. I will add a cover letter with our standard statement: "Redwood maintains a regular vulnerability program; no critical findings affecting service stability in last 12 months." (can tweak if Legal asks).
Marta: I'll prepare the diagram and a short architecture note mentioning: VPC peering requirements, NAT/Egress patterns, and KMS key policy snippet. I'll upload a PNG + plain-text notes.
Eli: Rough pricing ballpark (very rough): 4x A100 reserved 6mo commit ≈ $48,000/month; with burst buffer add +10-15%. I'll produce a proper quote (line items: GPU pool, networking egress, snapshot storage, reserved discount) by Monday.
Maya: Customer timeline: wants everything by next Tue COB. Any blockers?
Sam: SOC2 redaction + pen-test letter — should be OK by Tue if I get customer contact and NDA quick.
Abi: I'll provision the evidence bundle and send SFTP creds once Sam uploads the letters. I'll also include a checklist: SOC2 redacted, controls mapping, pen-test attestation, architecture diagram, contact/POC.
Maya: Sending customer contact now: Alice Chen <alice.chen@verdebank.com> (security lead). Alice has asked for a copy to be uploaded to their secure ShareFile too — I'll request the endpoint.
Sam: Got it — DM received. Sending initial pen-test attestation draft to this thread in a few hours for review.
Marta: Uploaded draft diagram: https://redwood-assets/diagrams/verdebank-poc-arch-v1.png (placeholder). Notes attached in the doc.
Abi: audit-bot: New evidence bundle created by Abi. ID: EB-2064-78. Link: https://evidence.redwood/EB-2064-78 (automated)
Maya: Perfect — I'll loop in the customer with the expected delivery timeline. If Security or Quotes need anything else, ping me here. :thumbsup:
